data.privacyPolicy:
Ivy Hall (accessible from www.ivyhalldispensary.com) is focused on the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that are collected and recorded by Ivy Hall and how we use it.
If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.
This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in Ivy Hall. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website.

Consent

By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

Information we collect

The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.
If you contact us directly, we may receive additional information about you such as your name, email address, phone number, the contents of the message and/or attachments you may send us, and any other information you may choose to provide.
When you register for an Account, we may ask for your contact information, including items such as name, company name, address, email address, and telephone number.

How we use your information

We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:
  • Provide, operate, and maintain our website
  • Improve, personalize, and expand our website
  • Understand and analyze how you use our website
  • Develop new products, services, features, and functionality
  • Communicate with you, either directly or through one of our partners, including for customer service, to provide you with updates and other information relating to the website, and for marketing and promotional purposes
  • Send you emails
  • Find and prevent fraud

Log files

Ivy Hall follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services' analytics. The information collected by log files includes internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users' movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.

Cookies and web beacons

Like any other website, Ivy Hall uses 'cookies'. These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users' experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors' browser type and/or other information.

Advertising partners privacy policies

You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of Ivy Hall. Third-party ad servers or ad networks use technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on Ivy Hall, which are sent directly to users' browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.
Note that Ivy Hall has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.

Third party privacy policies

Ivy Hall's Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.
You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers' respective websites.

Ccpa privacy rights (do not sell my personal information)

Under the CCPA, among other rights, California consumers have the right to:
  • Request that a business that collects a consumer's personal data disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal data that a business has collected about consumers.
  • Request that a business delete any personal data about the consumer that a business has collected.
  • Request that a business that sells a consumer's personal data, not sell the consumer's personal data.
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

Gdpr data protection rights

We would like to make sure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights. Every user is entitled to the following:
  • The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data. We may charge you a small fee for this service.
  • The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate. You also have the right to request that we complete the information you believe is incomplete.
  • The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

Children's information

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.
Ivy Hall does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 21. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

For further information:

If you have questions, need further assistance regarding or would like to submit a request pursuant to this Notice, you may contact the Ivy Hall Privacy Officer at support@ivyhalldispensary.com, or by mail at:
Ivy Hall
1720 N Damen Ave
Chicago, IL 60647

storeInfo.name: Ivy Hall Peoria
storeInfo.description:
Ivy Hall is a warm, inviting experiential dispensary with concierge-level service. It’s a place to embrace both the experience and the product.

We offer a focused curation for all guests, whether it’s for the new cannabis consumer or the seasoned veteran, we have the most desired assortment of cannabis strains and products available in the state of Illinois. 

Payment Methods Accepted : Cash, Debit Card, Aeropay (ATM on site). There is a $3.50 surcharge when using Debit Card.

contacts.address: 3929 W. War Memorial Dr. Peoria, IL 61615

content.name: We've Missed You! Freshly Picked For You

products.name: Meowzers
products.description:
Triangle Kush Purple Pakistani x Lemon Maraschin

Medium evenly branched traditional Afghani type plants with purple, apple red, and black flowers to be found. Extremely rank watermelon, cat piss, motor oil and cognac vapors with the taste to match. Heavy sedative high, good for pain relief, and anxiety. High-yielding capabilities with proper pruning and leaf removal. Also a great plant for those with limited ceiling height, and perfect for SOG grows. She is a newborn classic.

products.name: Landslide
products.description:
Type: Indica-dominant hybrid concentrate (derived from the Landslide strain, commonly bred as Lava Cake x Fleetwood Mac)

Aroma/Flavor: Sweet, earthy, and spicy chocolate undertones typical of the Landslide lineage.

products.name: Mac N' Jelly
products.description:
MAC and Jelly, also known as “MAC Jelly,” “Jelly MAC” and “MAC'N Jelly,” is a slightly indica dominant hybrid strain (60% indica/40% sativa) created through crossing the potent MAC X Jelly Breath strains. A deliciously potent bud with an amazing flavor to go with it, MAC and Jelly is a great choice for any hybrid lover. 

This bud has a sour citrusy flavor with hints of sweet flowery lavender and a pleasant earthiness. The aroma is very similar, although it does have a noticeable spicy diesel effect to it, too. MAC and Jelly buds have dense, grape-shaped dark forest green nugs with deep purple undertones, furry thin orange hairs and tiny, dark purple-tinted white crystal trichomes.

products.name: Sunset Octane
products.description:
Sunset Octane

Parents: Sunset Sherbet × High Octane OG BX3

Type: Hybrid (often exhibiting sativa-leaning effects with dense, OG-style bud structure)

Aroma: Pungent tropical gas, diesel, and subtle creamy or vanilla undertones

Flavor: Bright citrus and sweet cream on the exhale with diesel fuel finishes

Dominant Terpenes: Limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool

products.name: Blood Honey
products.description:
Blood Honey (also called Blood Honey Reloaded) is a balanced hybrid cannabis strain created by crossing Forbidden Fruit and Red Runtz. It was originally bred by Exotic Genetix.

Type: Hybrid (roughly 50% indica / 50% sativa to 60/40).

Parents: Forbidden Fruit × Red Runtz.

products.name: Spirit Quest
products.description:
0.5g live resin vape

Spirit Quest by Seed & Strain is a sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis cultivar created by crossing Malawi x Northern Lights #5 with Faceoff OG

Aroma & Flavor: Earthy, woody, and herbal notes with subtle spice and haze undertones.

products.name: Velvet Glove
products.description:
0.5g live resin vape

Lineage: GMO (Chem Dawg x Girl Scout Cookies) × Nookies (Tangie x Girl Scout Cookies variant or related cookie cross)

Breeder: Swamp Boys Seeds 


Aroma & Flavor: Pungent chemical/diesel funk, earthy mustiness, and savory garlic-cookie notes backed by subtle hints of sweet citrus and dark berries.

Appearance: Dense, resinous buds featuring deep purple hues, forest greens, and bright orange pistils

products.name: Cross of the Titans
products.description:
0.5g live resin vape

Genetics: Created by crossing Best Sht Ever* with (Medusa x Pegasus)

Aroma: Earthy and woody with notes of sweet citrus and pine.

Flavor: Smooth and citrusy with an herbal taste and a slight spicy finish.

Dominant Terpenes: Myrcene, Limonene, and Caryophyllene
